Culture, not politics. Lebanese weddings include Maronite and other Christian, Muslim (Sunni and Shia) and Druze families; do not present every custom as religious; faith or regional differences only where sourced.

Likely customs (brief finalises): the formal asking and engagement; the henna night; the zaffeh with drums and dancers; dabke; zaghareet; the sword cutting of the cake (often told); sugared almonds and wedding sweets; the bride's departure from the family home; church crowning or katb al-kitab only where sourced.
